LANDLORD AND TENANT [CH.161 – 1
LANDLORD AND TENANT
CHAPTER 161
LANDLORD AND TENANT
ARRANGEMENT OF SECTIONS
SECTION
1. Short title.
2. Goods taken in execution not removed unless party taking pay rent due.
3. Action for arrears of rent against tenant for life.
4. Distress for arrears on leases determined.
5. Limitation of such distress.
6. Proviso for the Crown.
